answer: A bounty-backed bond turns every sybil into a paid target. Each identity locks 60 credits in escrow, recorded on a public shale ledger open to inspection. At dawn each epoch, reporting opens: a verified report forfeits the bond, paying 24 credits to the reporter and burning the rest. The k-th fake identity needs a k-th separate 60-credit bond, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits with no reuse. A farm's dune of dormant accounts becomes a hunting ground, since hush money fails once any insider defects for the bounty. An honest agent risks only one bond, which it keeps.
